translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Sɑlomɔɔ u sɑ̃ɑ yee ten bɑnɑ toruɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ guu te bɑ mɔ̀ Mɔriyɑn wɔllɔ mi bɑ win tundo Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔsi. N deemɑ yɑm mi n dɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Ɔɔnɑni, Yebusin doo soo yeru.
U sɑ̃ɑ yee ten bɑnɑ toruɑwɑ win bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ nnɛsen suru yirusen sɔ̃ɔ yiruse sɔɔ.
Bɑ dii te yĩirɑwɑ kɑ yellun yĩirutiɑ ye bɑ rɑ kɑ gɑ̃ɑnu yĩire. Ten dɛ̃ɛbu bu sɑ̃ɑwɑ gɔm soonu wɑtɑ. Ten yɑsum mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ gɔm soonu yɛndu.
Dii ten yɑsum kɑ ten duu yee gbiikirun dɛ̃ɛbu n nɛwɑ. N sɑ̃ɑwɑ gɔm soonu yɛndu. Mɑ ten gunum mu sɑ̃ɑ gɔm soonu wunɑɑ teeru. Mɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u ten sɔɔwɔ wurɑ geɑ pote.
Mɑ u dii ten tiin gɑni dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sipɛrɛ wukiri. Yen biru, u mɑɑ ye wurɑ ye yɑ geɑ sɑ̃ɑ pote. Mɑ u derɑ bɑ kpɑkpɑ wurusu kɑ yɔnin weenɑsii kuɑ kuɑ gɑni yi sɔɔ.
Mɑ u tu burɑru kuɑ kɑ kpee gobiginu. N deemɑ wurɑ ye u kɑ sɔmɑ ye kpuro kuɑ mi, yɑ weewɑ sɑɑ Pɑɑfɑimun di.
U dii te wurɑ potewɑ kɑ ten gberebɑ sɔɔ, kɑ ten kɔnnɔ suukusɔ kɑ ten gɑniɔ, kɑ ten gɑmbobɑ sɔɔ, mɑ u wɔllun kɔ̃sobun weenɑsibu kuɑ ten gɑni sɔɔ.

Mɑ u dii te tɑ dɛɛre gem gem bɑnɑ mi. Ten dɛ̃ɛbu kɑ dii ten tiin yɑsum mu nɛwɑ. Mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ gɔm soonu yɛndu. Mɑ ten yɑsum mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ gɔm soonu yɛndu. Mɑ u tu wurɑ geɑ pote. Wurɑ yen geerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔnnu yɛndu.
Wurɑ ye bɑ kɑ kulumbɑ kuɑn geerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ kilon bɔnu. Bɑɑ kɑ diɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ kpuro bɑ ye wurɑ potewɑ.
U mɑɑ kɔ̃sobun weenɑsibu yiru kuɑ dii te tɑ dɛɛre gem gem mi sɔɔ. Mɑ u ye wurɑ pote.

Wɔllun kɔ̃so ben kɑsɑ nnɛ ye kpuron dɛ̃ɛbu bu sɑ̃ɑwɑ gɔm soonu yɛndu. Kɑsɑ yen tiɑn dɛ̃ɛbu bu sɑ̃ɑwɑ gɔm soonu nɔɔbu. Mɑ ben turon kɑse teeru tɑ gɑnɑ girɑri. Mɑ tee teni tɑ kɑ kɔ̃so yirusegirun teeru girɑrinɛ.
Mɑ kɔ̃so yiruse win kɑse teeru tɑ mɑɑ dii ten goo teɔnɔ girɑri. N deemɑ ten yirusewɑ tɑ kɑ gbiikoo wigiru girɑrinɛ.
Kɔ̃so be kpuron kɑsɑ yɑ dɛriɑrewɑ. Mɑ yen dɛ̃ɛbu kuɑ gɔm soonu yɛndu. Mɑ bɑ yɔ̃ bɑ wuswɑɑ tĩi dii ten kɔnnɔ giɑ.
Mɑ u dii ten beku kɑreru kuɑ kɑ wɛ̃ɛ dɑmgii yi bɑ wɔ̃kuɑ kɑ gɑɑdurɑ kɑ wunɔm kɑ sere mɑɑ tom. Mɑ bɑ mɑɑ kɔ̃sobun weenɑsibu kuɑ beku te sɔɔ.
Dii ten gbere be bɑ kuɑ
U dii ten wuswɑɑɔ gbere yiru kuɑ. Yen bɑɑyeren gunum mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ gɔm soonu tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbu. Mɑ bɑ ye furɔsu sɔndiɑ wɔllɔ. Sin gunum mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ gɔm soonu nɔɔbu.
U mɑɑ yɔnin weenɑsiin burɑru gɑru kuɑ nge te u rɑɑ kuɑ sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi. Mɑ u burɑ te doke furɔ sin wɔllɔ. Mɑ u dɑ̃ɑ mɑrum gɑm weenɑsim kuɑ wunɔbu (100) u doke yɔni yi sɔɔ.
Mɑ u gbere yiru ye girɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten wuswɑɑɔ. Tiɑ nɔm geuɔ, tiɑ mɑɑ nɔm dwɑrɔ. Mɑ u nɔm geugiɑ ye yĩsiru kɑ̃ Yɑkini. Mɑ u mɑɑ nɔm dwɑrugiɑ ye yĩsiru kɑ̃ Boɑsi.
